note: Frozen inputs for ContentHelp.reSegment. Every case with reSegment=true is run twice by the oracle and refused if the two runs differ, so a golden here is a deterministic frozen result; forceSplit's Math.random() branch (ContentHelp.kt:160) is therefore absent from this corpus and is covered by seeded unit tests instead.

cases.name: enabled-observed-shape
cases.note: The 21-of-1419 shape: a book whose readConfig.reSegment is on. Paragraphs, blank lines and dialogue, all deterministic.
cases.content:
第一章 初入宗门

清晨，山间的雾气还没有散尽。少年背着竹篓，一步步走上石阶。

“你终于来了。”老者站在门前，声音沙哑。

少年停下脚步，抬头看了他一眼。

cases.name: enabled-blank-lines-merge
cases.note: A paragraph that does not end in a sentence end is glued to the next; blank lines collapse.
cases.content:
第一段没有句末标点
第二段也没有标点。


第三段结束了。

cases.name: enabled-dialogue-quotes
cases.note: Dialogue and quote direction: an opening quote, a mid-line close/open pair, and an enumeration.
cases.content:
“走吧。”她说，“再不走就来不及了。”
他买了“锅”、“碗”、“盆”三样东西。

cases.name: enabled-ideographic-space
cases.note: An ideographic space and a tab are removed inside a paragraph, as the frozen `[\u3000\s]` class does.
cases.content:
前　言。

	本书是测试。

cases.name: enabled-title-equals-first-line
cases.note: The first line is the chapter title, so reSegment must not repeat it.
cases.content:
第四章 风起

风从山谷里吹来。树叶翻了个身。
